body: @bbaddepudi can  you please assign this issue to me?
Thx @viswanathreddy for offering to look into this.
@bbaddepudi I am trying to reproduce the issue. I have cloned and build the codebase successfully. But i don't see yb-admin file in the yugabyte-db/bin folder. Am i missing something?
@viswanathreddy It should be there in build/latest/bin folder.

@viswanathreddy --

if you are looking at the source tree for the binary -- https://github.com/YugaByte/yugabyte-db/tree/master/bin, please note that this is an executable that's a generated binary when you do a build of the source, and as @ndeodhar mentioned, the binary will land in build/latest/bin folder.

The starting point / source code for yb-admin is:

https://github.com/YugaByte/yugabyte-db/blob/master/src/yb/tools/yb-admin_cli.cc

@bbaddepudi Though UI doesn't show removed server, 'bin/yb-ctl status' command still shows removed server. Does it mean the server is not actually removed? Will have to check the inconsistency between UI results and yb-ctl status command results

Hey @viswanathreddy , I think `yb-ctl status` is based off of directory structure on disk, as it is a local testing tool.

What part of the UI are you checking to confirm the server is correctly removed? Is it just the main master leader UI (say `localhost:7000/`) ? If the server you removed no longer shows up there, then the command did the right thing. You can also further validate by running the `yb-admin list_all_masters`, to see if the removed master shows up there or not.
